ir.name: builder_pairs_margin_topk_003
ir.intuition: Construct pairwise preferences by comparing objective values and keeping only sufficiently separated (margin) winner/loser pairs, then cap globally with a deterministic top-k on the objective gap so training focuses on clearer wins within a fixed budget.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Configurable thresholds/budgets
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    # Build all (winner, loser) where objective_winner + gap_thr < objective_loser
    ow = objective[:, :, None]
    ol = objective[:, None, :]
    gap = (ol - ow)
    mask = gap > gap_thr
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    n = b_idx.numel()
    if n > max_pairs:
        # Deterministic selection: keep pairs with largest objective gaps
        pair_gap = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
        topk_idx = pair_gap.topk(k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'pairs_margin_topk', 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'gap_threshold': gap_thr})
